Legal Basis: Civil Code of the Philippines, Articles 2176 (Quasi-Delict Definition), 2180 (Employer Liability), and 2194 (Solidary Liability). Quasi-delict covers negligence-based damages even without a contract.
</LawCallout>

- Text: CRITICAL DISTINCTION: Article 1723 = STRUCTURAL COLLAPSE ONLY + requires CONTRACTUAL relationship. Article 2176 (Quasi-delict) = ANY NEGLIGENCE causing damage + applies even WITHOUT a contract. A third party injured by falling debris has a quasi-delict claim, not an Article 1723 claim.
[/SLATECAMP_UI_BLOCK]
